PYTHONUTF8: "1"

jobs:
  receiver-native:
    name: receiver-native (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-22.04, rust: '1.75' }
          - { os: macos-14, rust: '1.81' }
          - { os: windows-2022, rust: '1.75' }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Record immutable source identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p receiver-native-source-proof
          git rev-parse HEAD | tee receiver-native-source-proof/head.log
          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' | tee receiver-native-source-proof/tree.log
          git status --short | tee receiver-native-source-proof/status.log
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
      - name: Verify receiver source and migration contracts
        id: receiver_source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 scripts/test-support-receiver-input.py 2>&1 | tee receiver-native-source-proof/source-controls.log
      - name: Verify actual native receipt source and transition core
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 scripts/test-receiver-native.py --source-only 2>&1 | tee receiver-native-source-proof/receipt-source-controls.log
          python3 scripts/test-receiver-native.py --native --proof-root receiver-native-receipts-proof 2>&1 | tee receiver-native-source-proof/receipt-native.log
      - name: Verify actual Linux input-device ownership and bounded cancellation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test-support-receiver-uinput.py
          python3 scripts/test-support-receiver-uinput-deps.py
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Linux" ]; then
            python3 scripts/fixtures/receiver-uinput-native/prepare.py \
              --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mixel-receiver-uinput" --run --tokio
          fi
      - name: Verify scoped Windows secure-attention source and component preparation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test-receiver-sas.py
          python3 scripts/fixtures/receiver-sas-native/test_prepare.py
      - name: Activate Windows component linker
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/activate-windows-msvc.ps1 -ExportToGitHubEnvironment
      - name: Compile entire Windows secure-attention leaf and exercise kernel refusals
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          source scripts/use-windows-msvc-bash.sh
          python scripts/fixtures/receiver-sas-native/prepare.py \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/mixel-receiver-sas" --run
      - name: Compile and exercise exact receiver capability component
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.receiver_source.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: python3 scripts/test-support-receiver-input-native.py --output receiver-native-proof
      - name: Retain actual receiver component output and source bindings
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: receiver-native-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: |
            receiver-native-proof/*.log
            receiver-native-proof/*.json
            receiver-native-proof/component/Cargo.toml
            receiver-native-proof/component/Cargo.lock
            receiver-native-proof/component/tests/*.rs
            receiver-native-receipts-proof/
            receiver-native-source-proof/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-uinput/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-uinput/*.stdout
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-uinput/*.stderr
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-sas/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-sas/*/stdout
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-sas/*/stderr
            ${{ runner.temp }}/mixel-receiver-sas/*/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  release-pipeline:
    if: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.receiver_native_only) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
